content.title: Where to watch all the 2026 Oscars Best Picture nominees — including 'One Battle After Another'
content.text: 10 films were tapped as contenders for Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards: Bugonia, F1, Frankenstein, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, One Battle After Another, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, Sinners, and Train Dreams. But in the end, Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another took home the title. Every Best Picture nominee this year is currently available to stream or at least rent digitally (which isn't the case every year — oh, and if you're looking for a way to watch the Best Picture nominees with ASL interpretation, that's available too). Here's how to watch all the 2026 Best Picture nominees, plus the full list of 2026 Oscar winners.Bugonia (2025)Emma Stone and Jesse Plemons star in Yorgos Lanthimos’s dark comedy. The genre-bending satire has received plenty of awards season buzz, with both leads nominated in their respective categories at the upcoming 2026 Actors Awards.Where to watch: Bugonia is currently available to stream on Peacock.Watch on PeacockF1: The Movie (2025)Starring Brad Pitt and Damson Idris, Joseph Kosinski’s thrilling sports film not only managed to shoot during real Grand Prix events, it pulled off an unexpected Best Picture nomination too.Where to watch: You can stream F1 on Apple TV.Watch on Apple TVFrankenstein (2025)Oscar Isaac and Jacob Elordi star in Guillermo del Toro’s Frankenstein. This gothic horror adaptation of Mary Shelley’s classic novel received five Golden Globe nominations and won four Critics' Choice Awards.Where to watch: You can stream Frankenstein (2025) on Netflix.Watch on NetflixHamnet (2025)Jessie Buckley and Paul Mescal star in Chloé Zhao’s adaptation of Maggie O’Farrell’s novel, Hamnet. Co-written by Zhao and O’Farrell, Hamnet (2025) received the People’s Choice Award at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) and won for both Best Motion Picture – Drama and Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama at the 2026 Golden Globe Awards.Where to watch: Hamnet is now streaming on Peacock.Watch on PeacockMarty Supreme (2025)Timothée Chalamet stars in Josh Safdie’s chaotic sports dramedy, alongside Gwyneth Paltrow, Odessa A’zion, Kevin O’Leary, Tyler Okonma, Abel Ferrara and Fran Drescher. Loosely inspired by table tennis legend Marty Reisman, Marty Supreme received three nominations at the 2026 Golden Globes, with Chalamet winning for Best Actor.Where to watch: Marty Supreme is available to rent or buy on Apple TV, Amazon, and most VOD platforms.Rent or buy on Apple TVOne Battle After Another (2025)Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Benicio Del Toro, Teyana Taylor, Chase Infinity and Regina Hall star in Paul Thomas Anderson’s action-packed political dramedy. One Battle After Another was the most-nominated film at the 2026 Golden Globes, taking home Best Picture, among others, and has received a record-setting 7 nominations for the 2026 Actor Awards.Where to watch: You can stream One Battle After Another on HBO Max.Watch on HBO MaxSentimental Value (2025)Renate Reinsve, Stellan Skarsgård, Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas and Elle Fanning star in this quiet family drama from director and co-writer Joachim Trier (The Worst Person in the World). Sentimental Value won the Grand Prix at Cannes and received eight nominations at the 2026 Golden Globes, with Stellan Skarsgård taking home the award for Best Supporting Actor. Currently,Where to watch: You can rent or buy Sentimental Value on Apple TV, Amazon, and most VOD platforms.Rent or buy on Apple TVSinners (2025)Michael B. Jordan stars as two twin brothers in Ryan Coogler’s genre-blending horror film, alongside a cast which includes Hailee Steinfeld, Miles Caton, Jack O’Connell and Wunmi Mosaku. The period piece took home the prizes for Cinematic and Box Office Achievement and Best Original Score at the 2026 Golden Globes and topped the Critics' Choice Awards with 17 nominations.Where to watch: You can stream Sinners on HBO Max or Prime Video.Watch on HBO MaxWatch on Prime VideoThe Secret Agent (2025)Wagner Moura stars in Kleber Mendonça Filho’s neo-noir political thriller, set in Brazil in 1977. The Secret Agent was the most awarded film at Cannes, and took home Golden Globe Awards for Best Motion Picture – Non-English Language and Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama, making Wagner Moura the first Brazilian actor to win in that category.Where to watch: You can currently stream The Secret Agent on Hulu.Watch via Disney+Train Dreams (2025)Joel Edgerton and Felicity Jones star in Clint Bentley’s period drama, which premiered at Sundance and has received recognition from both the Golden Globes and the Critics' Choice Awards, where the film won for Best Cinematography.Where to watch: You can stream Train Dreams on Netflix.Watch on NetflixWhen are the Oscars this year?The 98th Academy Awards will be held this Sunday, March 15, 2026/2026 Oscars start time:The Oscars will begin at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT this Sunday. Official ABC red carpet coverage will start at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu.2026 Oscars TV channel:The Oscars will air on ABC and stream live on Hulu — and not fancy, live TV Hulu, just the regular old on-demand streaming platform.Where to stream the 2026 Oscars:And the 2026 Oscar winners and nominees are…Best Picture• Bugonia• F1• Frankenstein• Hamnet• Marty Supreme• One Battle After Another — winner• The Secret Agent• Sentimental Value• Sinners• Train DreamsDirecting• Chloé Zhao, Hamnet• Josh Safdie, Marty Supreme• Paul Thomas Anderson, One Battle After Another — winner• Joachim Trier, Sentimental Value• Ryan Coogler, SinnersActor in a Leading Role• Timothée Chalamet, Marty Supreme• Leonardo DiCaprio, One Battle After Another• Ethan Hawke, Blue Moon• Michael B.
